name: submit_report
description: Saves the report the farmer confirmed, when the assessment ends or if it can't be assessed.

user_statement.description: Summary of what the farmer said, in their own words

symptoms.description: Concrete symptoms they mentioned, for example 'yellow spots on leaves'

items.description: One concrete symptom, for example 'yellow spots on leaves'

completeness.description: sufficient if the assessment ended with guidance; partial otherwise

assessment_id.description: assessment_id from the last assess_observation response, if any
